categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: semiconductor advanced packaging process equipment, printed circuit board (PCB) process equipment, and advanced process and other electronic application equipment. It focuses on bonding, lamination, peeling, thermal, UV, wet process, and plasma technologies for semiconductor packaging, PCB manufacturing, and display panel production. The company also engages in machinery installation, optical instrument manufacturing, telecommunications equipment, international trade, and consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include bonding, lamination, peeling, thermal processing, UV curing, wet processing, and plasma treatment. The company develops advanced equipment such as vacuum lamination systems, hybrid bonding process equipment, various ovens for semiconductor packaging, UV surface cleaning machines, and plasma deep etching equipment. Production involves sheet metal fabrication, outsourcing of parts, assembly, electrical wiring, testing, and quality assurance following ISO 9001 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor foundries, OSATs (outsourced semiconductor assembly and test providers), PCB manufacturers, and display panel producers. The company serves major players in AI chip advanced packaging, high bandwidth memory (HBM), and advanced PCB substrates. Markets include AI, HPC, 5G, IoT, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics sectors, with customers primarily in Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, the US, Japan, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing and sales facilities in Taiwan (Linkou, Taichung), China (Guangzhou, Kunshan), and has expanded to Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, India, the US, and Japan. It targets the Greater China region and emerging economies while also serving advanced markets in North America, Europe, and Japan. Distribution channels include dealers in Hong Kong, Japan, the US, Korea, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and electronics supply chain, supplying advanced process equipment for semiconductor packaging, PCB fabrication, and display panel manufacturing. It provides critical manufacturing tools and solutions to foundries, OSATs, and PCB fabricators, enabling downstream chip and system assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding advanced packaging equipment for 2.5D/3D ICs, FoPLP, Micro LED, and high-end PCB substrates. The company emphasizes energy-saving, environmental sustainability, and circular economy principles. R&D focuses on core technologies integration, automation, AI-driven process innovation, and collaboration with strategic partners (G2C+ alliance) to enhance product portfolios and market reach. It also invests in developing high-precision, high-efficiency production solutions for semiconductor and PCB advanced processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of manufacturing equipment and related process solutions. The company also earns income from machinery installation services, equipment maintenance, and distribution of third-party products. Revenue streams are tied to capital expenditures by semiconductor, PCB, and display panel manufacturers, with no significant subscription or licensing models reported.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in Taiwan and Greater China for advanced semiconductor packaging equipment, particularly in vacuum lamination, bonding, and baking ovens. It competes globally with other semiconductor equipment suppliers serving foundries and OSATs. Its unique capability to supply large-size TFT front-end multi-layer ovens and advanced PCB lamination and peeling machines distinguishes it in the market. It is recognized by major customers like TSMC and ASE as a key strategic partner.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported significant growth with 2024 revenues reaching approximately NT$4.8 billion, a 32.9% increase from the prior year. Operating profit increased by 58%, and net income attributable to the parent company rose by 47.9%. The company maintains a stable financial structure with increasing shareholder equity and manageable debt levels. It has expanded its workforce to over 1,000 employees and continues to invest about 7.5% of revenue in R&D. Growth is driven by surging demand in AI-driven semiconductor advanced packaging and PCB markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated core technologies in bonding, lamination, peeling, thermal, UV, wet, and plasma processes to deliver high-precision, energy-efficient, and reliable manufacturing equipment. It offers total solutions tailored for advanced semiconductor packaging and PCB fabrication, supporting customers’ needs for miniaturization, high performance, and cost efficiency. Its strong R&D capabilities, strategic partnerships, and proven track record with leading semiconductor manufacturers provide competitive differentiation. The company also prioritizes sustainability and innovation to meet evolving market demands.
